Revision number (in mscore/revision.h) is incorrect in the assets available above (autogenerated by GitHub). **Source code is available here:** https://download.musescore.com/releases/MuseScore-3.0.1/MuseScore-3.0.1.zip

Improvements

* Redesign of New Score Wizard makes it easier to search templates, provides better score previews, and significantly improves accessibility for blind users * Reworked Mixer UI allows minimizing and making it dockable * Better automatic placement of hairpins and dynamics * Better import of 2.X scores

Fixes
